title: Check IgnitionLaneActivityModel in SSMS for MissingDimensionData after a power flicker
summary: Use SSMS to inspect the lane activity database model/view [dbo].[IgnitionLaneActivityHodel] / [dbo].[IgnitionLaneActivityModel] and confirm whether the MissingDimensionData field is flagged for lane activity rows in the affected time window after a power flicker. This provides database evidence that upstream dimension data did not reboot properly.
